name: S1ThreatContext
author: Citadelis
description: Look up a SentinelOne threat by ID and return its details plus what its storyline did on the endpoint: processes, network connections, DNS lookups, file and registry changes. Read-only.

configurationItems.name: url
configurationItems.description: SentinelOne console base URL, e.g. https://<tenant>.sentinelone.net

configurationItems.name: api_token
configurationItems.description: Read-only SentinelOne API token (Viewer role or view-only service user)

configurationItems.name: max_events
configurationItems.description: Hard cap on the number of storyline events returned
